data.name: Philip
data.gender_notes: Philip is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek philos, 'loving', + hippos, 'horse' — 'lover of horses'. Its root is Greek philos + hippos. Philip the Apostle; Philip the Evangelist. Philip is a Greek name meaning “Lover of horses”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Philip expresses “Lover of horses”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek philos, 'loving', + hippos, 'horse' — 'lover of horses'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Philip total 43, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
